  <h2>Method note</h2>
  <div class="method">
    <p id="method-note">For every county in the district, the model estimates how many ballots are left to be counted using registration and 2022 turnout, or the county’s report of unprocessed ballot numbers. I assume outstanding ballots split similar to already-counted ballots, with an error accounting for differences in late vote. After election night, the model estimates the shift in late vote by comparing each incoming batch to the previous count.</p>
    <p>This is <em>not</em> an official result. Margin is taken as Thompson vote share minus Jones vote share, in percentage points. The page checks for new data every minute.</p>
    <p class="small">Sources: California Secretary of State election results. Map: AB 604 (Prop 50) congressional district from the Statewide Database, and Census Bureau county boundaries. <a id="repo-link" href="#">Code and data</a>.</p>
  </div>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  const DATA_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zacharylhertz/needle-ca04/main/data/live/state.json";
  const GEO_URL = "ca04_counties.geojson";
  const REPO_URL = "https://github.com/zacharylhertz/needle-ca04";
  const POLL_MS = 60000;
  const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 20000;
  // The model rewrites updated_at every run (about every 5 minutes), so 20 minutes without a new file means it stopped.
  const PAGE_STALE_MS = 20 * 60000;
  const COLORS = { T: "#127A6E", J: "#B35C00" };
  const T_NAME = "Thompson", J_NAME = "Jones";
  // Map bins, lightest to darkest.
  const RAMP = {
    T: ["#cfe8e4", "#8cc7bf", "#3f9a8f", "#0f5f56"],
    J: ["#f6dcc3", "#e9ad78", "#cc7a2e", "#8a4500"],
    G: ["#e6e3ef", "#bdb5d6", "#8b7fb8", "#574a8c"]
  };
  // Vote share uses CA-11's four binned steps of the leader's two-candidate share.
  const SHARE_BINS = [55, 60, 70], SHARE_LABELS = ["50 to 55", "55 to 60", "60 to 70", "70 plus"];
  const SWING_BINS = [5, 10, 20], SWING_LABELS = ["0 to 5", "5 to 10", "10 to 20", "20 plus"];
  const COUNTED_BINS = [25, 50, 75], COUNTED_LABELS = ["0 to 25%", "25 to 50%", "50 to 75%", "75% plus"];
  // Size of lead: circle area proportional to the lead in votes (fixed scale, map units on a 600-wide map).
  const LEAD_REF = 2000, LEAD_CLAMP = 8000, LEAD_RMAX = 22;
  const leadRadius = function (lead) { return LEAD_RMAX * Math.sqrt(Math.min(Math.abs(lead), LEAD_CLAMP) / LEAD_REF); };
  // Labels come from by_county[].label; failing that, the county name plus "(part)" when by_county[].whole_county is false.

  const override = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("data");
  const url = override || DATA_URL;
  const $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  $("repo-link").href = REPO_URL;
  if (override) {
    $("test-notice").hidden = false;
    $("test-notice").textContent = "Test mode. Data comes from " + override + ", not the live file.";
  }

  /* ---------- formatting ---------- */
  const isNum = function (x) { return typeof x === "number" && isFinite(x); };
  const NA = "n/a";
  const int = function (x) { return isNum(x) ? Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-US") : NA; };
  const pct1 = function (x) { return isNum(x) ? x.toFixed(1) + "%" : NA; };
  const margin = function (x) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return NA;
    const v = Math.abs(x).toFixed(1);
    if (v === "0.0") return "Even";
    return (x > 0 ? T_NAME : J_NAME) + " +" + v;
  };
  const prob = function (p) {
    if (!isNum(p)) return NA;
    if (p >= 0.995) return ">99%";
    if (p <= 0.005) return "<1%";
    return Math.round(p * 100) + "%";
  };
  const pctIn = function (p) {
    if (!isNum(p)) return NA;

    if (p < 1) return "<1%";
    if (p > 99 && p < 100) return ">99%";
    return Math.round(Math.min(p, 100)) + "%";
  };
  const rangeText = function (lo, hi) { return isNum(lo) && isNum(hi) ? margin(lo) + " to " + margin(hi) : NA; };
  const swingText = function (x) {
    if (!isNum(x)) return NA;
    const v = Math.abs(x).toFixed(1);
    return v === "0.0" ? "None" : (x > 0 ? T_NAME : J_NAME) + " +" + v;
  };
  const axisLabel = function (v) { return v === 0 ? "Even" : (v > 0 ? "T+" : "J+") + Math.abs(v); };

  const TZ = "America/Los_Angeles";
  const timeFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: TZ, hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
  const dayFmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: TZ, month: "short", day: "numeric" });
  const validDate = function (iso) { return typeof iso === "string" && !isNaN(Date.parse(iso)); };
  const clock = function (ms) { return timeFmt.format(new Date(ms)).replace(/\s/g, " ").replace("AM", "am").replace("PM", "pm"); };
  const timePT = function (iso) { return validDate(iso) ? clock(Date.parse(iso)) + " PT" : NA; };
  const whenPT = function (iso) {
    if (!validDate(iso)) return NA;
    const d = new Date(iso);
    return dayFmt.format(d) === dayFmt.format(new Date()) ? timePT(iso) : dayFmt.format(d) + ", " + timePT(iso);
  };

  /* ---------- DOM helpers (data only goes in through textContent) ---------- */
  function clear(node) { while (node.firstChild) node.removeChild(node.firstChild); }
  function tintMargin(el, text) {
    el.classList.remove("m-t", "m-j");
    if (/^(T|Thompson) \+|toward Thompson$/.test(text)) el.classList.add("m-t");
    else if (/^(J|Jones) \+|toward Jones$/.test(text)) el.classList.add("m-j");
    return el;
  }

    const e = document.createElement(tag);

  }

      tr.appendChild(tintMargin(cell, String(c)));
    });

  }
  function emptyRow(body, cols, text) {
    const tr = document.createElement("tr");

    c.colSpan = cols;
    c.style.textAlign = "left";
    c.style.color = "var(--muted)";
    tr.appendChild(c);
    body.appendChild(tr);
  }
  const arr = function (x) { return Array.isArray(x) ? x : []; };
  const obj = function (x) { return x && typeof x === "object" && !Array.isArray(x) ? x : {}; };
  const svgEl = function (name, attrs) {

  };

  /* ---------- header and headline ---------- */
  function stateLine(s) {
    if (s.status === "pre") return "No votes counted yet";
    if (s.status === "counting") return "Counting";
    if (s.status === "final") return "All counties report their count complete. Results are not certified";
    if (s.status === "stale") return "The results feed has not changed since " + whenPT(obj(s.feed).last_change_at || s.updated_at);
    return "Status not available";
  }
  function renderHead(s) {
    $("state").textContent = stateLine(s);
    const feed = obj(s.feed);
    const bits = [];
    if (validDate(s.updated_at)) bits.push("Updated " + whenPT(s.updated_at) + ".");
    if (feed.sos_reporting_time) bits.push("Secretary of State report time: " + String(feed.sos_reporting_time).replace(/\.\s*$/, "") + ".");
    $("updated").textContent = bits.join(" ");
    $("fake-notice").hidden = !s.fake;
    $("fake-notice").textContent = s.fake ? "FAKE DATA. " + (typeof s.fake === "string" ? s.fake : "These numbers are a test fixture, not results.") : "";
    const o = s.ballots_outstanding;
    if (o && typeof o === "object" && isNum(o.total_ca04_est)) {
      $("outstanding").hidden = false;
      $("outstanding").textContent = "Ballots still to count in CA-04, estimated from county reports" +
        (validDate(o.as_of) ? " as of " + whenPT(o.as_of) : "") + ": about " + int(o.total_ca04_est) +
        (o.note ? " (" + o.note + ")" : "") + ".";
    } else $("outstanding").hidden = true;
  }

  let needleShown = false;
  function renderDial(s, pt, pj) {
    const arm = $("needle-arm"), hub = $("needle-hub"), dial = $("dial");
    dial.classList.toggle("is-stale", s.status === "stale");
    if (pt !== null) {
      const t = "rotate(" + ((Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pt)) - 0.5) * 180).toFixed(2) + "deg)";
      if (!needleShown) {
        arm.style.transform = t; arm.getBoundingClientRect(); arm.classList.add("ease");
        arm.setAttribute("visibility", "visible"); hub.setAttribute("visibility", "visible"); needleShown = true;
      } else if (arm.style.transform !== t) { arm.style.transform = t; }
      $("dial-title").textContent = "Dial showing a " + prob(pt) + " chance Thompson wins and a " + prob(pj) + " chance Jones wins." +
        (s.status === "stale" ? " The feed has stopped updating." : "");
    } else {
      arm.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"); hub.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
      needleShown = false; arm.classList.remove("ease");
      $("dial-title").textContent = "Dial showing the chance Thompson wins. No estimate yet.";
    }
  }
  function renderHeadline(s) {
    const e = obj(s.estimate);
    const pt = isNum(e.p_thompson) ? e.p_thompson : null;
    const pj = isNum(e.p_jones) ? e.p_jones : (pt !== null ? 1 - pt : null);
    if (pt === null) {
      $("p-label").textContent = "Chance of winning";
      $("p-big").textContent = NA;
      $("p-other").textContent = "";
    } else {
      const lead = pt >= pj ? T_NAME : J_NAME;
      const p = lead === T_NAME ? pt : pj;
      $("p-label").textContent = "Chance " + lead + " wins";
      $("p-big").textContent = prob(p);
      const other = lead === T_NAME ? J_NAME : T_NAME;
      $("p-other").textContent = "Chance " + other + " wins: " + prob(lead === T_NAME ? pj : pt);
    }
    renderDial(s, pt, pj);
    $("prior-note").hidden = !(s.status === "pre" || s.counted_votes === 0) || pt === null;

    // stats, as on the CA-11 page
    const x = obj(s.expected_total);
    tintMargin($("margin"), $("margin").textContent = margin(e.margin_mid));
    $("margin-range").textContent = isNum(e.margin_lo90) && isNum(e.margin_hi90) ? "90% interval: " + rangeText(e.margin_lo90, e.margin_hi90) : "";
    $("counted").textContent = int(s.counted_votes);
    $("expected").textContent = isNum(x.mid)
      ? "Estimated final total: " + int(x.mid) + (isNum(x.lo90) && isNum(x.hi90) ? "\n(range " + int(x.lo90) + " to " + int(x.hi90) + ")" : "") : "";
    $("share-counted").textContent = pctIn(s.pct_counted_est);
    if (isNum(s.counted_votes) && s.counted_votes > 0 && x.lo90 > 0 && x.hi90 > 0) {
      const lo = Math.min(100, 100 * s.counted_votes / x.hi90), hi = Math.min(100, 100 * s.counted_votes / x.lo90);
      $("share-range").textContent = "Range: " + Math.round(lo) + "% to " + Math.round(hi) + "%";
    } else $("share-range").textContent = "";
  }

  /* ---------- current count table and stacked bar (as on the CA-11 page) ---------- */
  const PARTY_NAMES = { DEM: "Democrat", Dem: "Democrat" };
  const FALLBACK_CANDIDATES = [{ name: "Mike Thompson", party: "DEM" }, { name: "Eric Jones", party: "DEM" }];
  const colorOf = function (c) { return whoIs(c.name) === J_NAME ? COLORS.J : COLORS.T; };
  function renderCount(s) {
    const body = $("count-body");
    clear(body);
    const list = arr(s.candidates).filter(function (c) { return c && whoIs(c.name); });
    const cands = list.length ? list : FALLBACK_CANDIDATES;
    const voteSum = cands.reduce(function (a, c) { return a + (isNum(c.votes) ? c.votes : 0); }, 0);
    cands.forEach(function (c) {
      const pct = isNum(c.pct) ? c.pct : (voteSum > 0 && isNum(c.votes) ? 100 * c.votes / voteSum : null);
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      const name = textEl("th", "", c.name || NA);
      name.scope = "row";
      name.style.setProperty("--edge", colorOf(c));
      tr.appendChild(name);
      tr.appendChild(textEl("td", "", PARTY_NAMES[c.party] || c.party || NA));
      tr.appendChild(textEl("td", "", int(c.votes)));
      const cell = textEl("td", "pct", "");
      const wrap = textEl("div", "pct-wrap", "");
      wrap.appendChild(textEl("span", "", pct1(pct)));
      const track = textEl("span", "bar-track", "");
      track.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      const fill = textEl("span", "bar-fill", "");
      fill.style.width = (isNum(pct) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct)) : 0) + "%";
      fill.style.background = colorOf(c);
      track.appendChild(fill);
      wrap.appendChild(track);
      cell.appendChild(wrap);
      tr.appendChild(cell);
      body.appendChild(tr);
    });
    const total = isNum(s.counted_votes) ? s.counted_votes : (voteSum > 0 ? voteSum : null);
    const totRow = document.createElement("tr");
    totRow.className = "total";
    const tn = textEl("th", "", "Total reported");
    tn.scope = "row";
    tn.colSpan = 2;
    totRow.appendChild(tn);
    totRow.appendChild(textEl("td", "", int(total)));
    totRow.appendChild(textEl("td", "", ""));
    body.appendChild(totRow);

    const stack = $("stack"), keys = $("stack-keys");
    clear(stack); clear(keys);
    const labels = [];
    cands.forEach(function (c) {
      const last = whoIs(c.name) || String(c.name || "");
      if (voteSum > 0 && isNum(c.votes) && c.votes > 0) {
        const seg = document.createElement("span");
        seg.style.width = (100 * c.votes / voteSum) + "%";
        seg.style.background = colorOf(c);
        stack.appendChild(seg);
        labels.push(last + " " + pct1(100 * c.votes / voteSum));
      }
      const k = document.createElement("span");
      const sw = document.createElement("i");
      sw.style.background = colorOf(c);
      k.appendChild(sw);
      k.appendChild(document.createTextNode(last));
      keys.appendChild(k);
    });
    stack.setAttribute("aria-label", labels.length ? labels.join(", ") + "." : "No votes reported yet.");
    // County parts whose SOS line reads "100% (n of n) precincts reporting".
    const parts = arr(s.by_county).filter(function (c) { return c && typeof c.county === "string"; });
    const done = parts.filter(function (c) { return /^100(\.0)?%/.test(String(c.sos_reporting || "")); }).length;
    $("stack-total").textContent = total === null ? "" : int(total) + " votes reported" +
      (parts.length ? ", with " + done + " of " + parts.length + " county parts reporting all precincts" : "");
  }

  function renderNeeds(s) {
    const t = obj(s.trailing_needs);
    $("needs").hidden = true;
    if (!t.available) return;
    const who = whoIs(t.trailer);
    if (!who || !isNum(t.lead_votes)) return;
    const parts = [who + " trails by " + int(t.lead_votes) + (Math.round(t.lead_votes) === 1 ? " vote." : " votes.")];
    if (isNum(t.remaining_votes_mid)) parts.push("The model expects about " + int(Math.round(t.remaining_votes_mid / 100) * 100) + " more votes in this race.");
    const n = t.needed_share_of_remaining;
    if (isNum(n) && n > 100) parts.push("That is fewer than " + who + " would need to catch up.");
    else if (isNum(n)) parts.push(who + " needs " + pct1(n) + " of them to pull even.");
    $("needs-title").textContent = "What " + who + " needs";
    $("needs-text").textContent = parts.join(" ");
    $("needs").hidden = false;
  }

  /* ---------- shared chart helpers (index-spaced, as on the CA-11 page) ---------- */
  function tickLabel(data, i) {
    const d0 = dayFmt.format(new Date(data[0].ms)), di = dayFmt.format(new Date(data[i].ms));
    return di === d0 ? clock(data[i].ms) : di;
  }
  function indexTicks(n, pw) {
    const maxTicks = Math.max(2, Math.floor(pw / 70));
    if (n <= maxTicks) return Array.from({ length: n }, function (_, i) { return i; });
    const step = Math.ceil((n - 1) / (maxTicks - 1)), out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i += step) out.push(i);
    if (out[out.length - 1] !== n - 1) { if (n - 1 - out[out.length - 1] < step / 2) out.pop(); out.push(n - 1); }
    return out;
  }
  const histFromState = function (s) {
    return arr(s.history)
      .filter(function (h) { return h && validDate(h.t); })
      .map(function (h) { return Object.assign({}, h, { ms: Date.parse(h.t) }); })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return a.ms - b.ms; });
  };
  function placeTip(g, x, lines) {
    clear(g.tip);
    lines.forEach(function (r) {
      if (r[0] === null) return;
      const line = document.createElement("div");
      line.appendChild(textEl("b", "", r[0]));
      line.appendChild(textEl("span", "", r[1] ? " " + r[1] : ""));
      g.tip.appendChild(line);
    });
    g.tip.hidden = false;
    const tw = g.tip.offsetWidth;
    g.tip.style.left = (x + 12 + tw > g.W ? Math.max(0, x - 12 - tw) : x + 12) + "px";
  }
  function wireIndexChart(box, getData, getGeom, show, hide, redraw) {
    function nearest(ev) {
      const g = getGeom(), data = getData();
      if (!g || !data.length) return;
      const px = ev.clientX - box.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      let best = 0, bestD = Infinity;
      data.forEach(function (h, i) { const d = Math.abs(g.xOf(i) - px); if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; } });
      show(best);
    }
    box.addEventListener("pointermove", nearest);
    box.addEventListener("pointerdown", nearest);
    box.addEventListener("pointerleave", hide);
    box.addEventListener("blur", hide);
    box.addEventListener("keydown", function (ev) {
      const data = getData(), g = getGeom();
      if (!data.length || !g) return;
      const n = data.length, cur = g.index !== null ? g.index : n - 1;
      let next = null;
      if (ev.key === "ArrowLeft") next = cur - 1;
      else if (ev.key === "ArrowRight") next = cur + 1;
      else if (ev.key === "Escape") { hide(); return; }
      if (next === null) return;

    if (window.ResizeObserver) {

      }).observe(box);
    }
  }
  // Path through points i in idx, split into solid and dashed pieces: the step into a reconstructed entry is dashed.
  function linePieces(data, idx, xOf, yOf, key) {
    const solid = [], dashed = [];
    for (let k = 1; k < idx.length; k++) {
      const a = data[idx[k - 1]], b = data[idx[k]];
      const d = "M" + xOf(idx[k - 1]).toFixed(1) + " " + yOf(a[key]).toFixed(1) + " L" + xOf(idx[k]).toFixed(1) + " " + yOf(b[key]).toFixed(1);
      (b.reconstructed ? dashed : solid).push(d);
    }
    return { solid: solid.join(" "), dashed: dashed.join(" ") };
  }
  function cursor(svg, m, ph, color) {
    const cross = svgEl("line", { y1: m.t, y2: m.t + ph, stroke: "#7a838e", "stroke-width": 1, visibility: "hidden" });
    const dot = svgEl("circle", { r: 4, fill: color, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 2, visibility: "hidden" });
    svg.appendChild(cross); svg.appendChild(dot);
    return { cross: cross, dot: dot };
  }

  /* ---------- chance Thompson wins over time ---------- */
  let histData = [], histGeom = null, histFav = T_NAME;
  function renderHistory(s) {
    const eNow = obj(s.estimate);
    histFav = isNum(eNow.p_thompson) && eNow.p_thompson < 0.5 ? J_NAME : T_NAME;
    const favP = function (h) { return isNum(h.p_thompson) ? (histFav === T_NAME ? h.p_thompson : 1 - h.p_thompson) : null; };
    $("hist-title").textContent = "Chance " + histFav + " wins over time";
    $("hist-col").textContent = "Chance " + histFav + " wins";
    $("hist-chart").setAttribute("aria-label", "Line chart of the chance " + histFav + " wins over time. Use the left and right arrow keys to move between updates.");
    histData = histFromState(s).filter(function (h) { return isNum(h.p_thompson); }).map(function (h) { return Object.assign({}, h, { p_fav: favP(h) }); });
    $("hist-empty").hidden = histData.length > 0;
    $("hist-chart").hidden = histData.length === 0;
    $("hist-keys").hidden = histData.length === 0;
    $("hist-key-rec").hidden = !histData.some(function (h) { return h.reconstructed; });
    const body = $("hist-body");
    clear(body);
    const all = histFromState(s);
    if (!all.length) emptyRow(body, 6, "No history yet.");
    all.slice().reverse().forEach(function (h) {
      body.appendChild(row([whenPT(h.t) + (h.reconstructed ? " (rebuilt)" : ""), prob(favP(h)), margin(h.margin_mid),
        rangeText(h.margin_lo90, h.margin_hi90), margin(h.reported_margin), int(h.counted_votes)]));
    });
    drawHistory();
  }
  function drawHistory() {
    const box = $("hist-chart");
    clear(box);
    const keep = histGeom ? histGeom.index : null;
    histGeom = null;
    if (!histData.length) return;
    const W = Math.max(280, box.clientWidth || 700);
    const H = W < 480 ? 200 : 240;
    const m = { l: 44, r: 58, t: 12, b: 26 };
    const pw = W - m.l - m.r, ph = H - m.t - m.b, n = histData.length;
    const xOf = function (i) { return n > 1 ? m.l + i / (n - 1) * pw : m.l + pw / 2; };
    const yOf = function (p) { return m.t + (1 - p) * ph; };
    const svg = svgEl("svg", { viewBox: "0 0 " + W + " " + H, height: H, "aria-hidden": "true" });
    [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].forEach(function (p) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", { x1: m.l, x2: W - m.r, y1: yOf(p), y2: yOf(p), stroke: p === 0.5 ? "#aab1ba" : "#e3e6ea", "stroke-width": 1 }));
      svgText(svg, m.l - 6, yOf(p) + 4, Math.round(p * 100) + "%", { "text-anchor": "end" });
    });
    indexTicks(n, pw).forEach(function (i) {
      svgText(svg, xOf(i), H - 6, tickLabel(histData, i), { "text-anchor": n > 1 && i === n - 1 ? "end" : (i === 0 && n > 1 ? "start" : "middle") });
    });
    const p = linePieces(histData, histData.map(function (_, i) { return i; }), xOf, yOf, "p_fav");
    const FC = histFav === T_NAME ? COLORS.T : COLORS.J;
    if (p.dashed) svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", { d: p.dashed, fill: "none", stroke: FC, "stroke-width": 2, "stroke-dasharray": "5 4" }));
    if (p.solid) svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", { d: p.solid, fill: "none", stroke: FC, "stroke-width": 2.5, "stroke-linejoin": "round" }));
    const last = histData[n - 1];
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("circle", { cx: xOf(n - 1), cy: yOf(last.p_fav), r: 4, fill: FC, stroke: "#fff", "stroke-width": 2 }));
    svgText(svg, xOf(n - 1) + 8, yOf(last.p_fav) + 4, prob(last.p_fav), { class: "end" });
    const c = cursor(svg, m, ph, FC);
    box.appendChild(svg);
    const tip = textEl("div", "tip", ""); tip.hidden = true; box.appendChild(tip);
    histGeom = { xOf: xOf, yOf: yOf, cross: c.cross, dot: c.dot, tip: tip, W: W, index: null };
    if (keep !== null && keep < n) showHist(keep);
  }
  function showHist(i) {
    if (!histGeom || !histData[i]) return;
    const g = histGeom, h = histData[i], x = g.xOf(i);
    g.index = i;
    g.cross.setAttribute("x1", x); g.cross.setAttribute("x2", x); g.cross.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
    g.dot.setAttribute("cx", x); g.dot.setAttribute("cy", g.yOf(h.p_fav)); g.dot.setAttribute("visibility", "visible");
    placeTip(g, x, [[prob(h.p_fav), "chance " + histFav + " wins"], [int(h.counted_votes), "votes counted"], [whenPT(h.t), h.reconstructed ? "(rebuilt)" : ""]]);
  }
  function hideHist() {
    if (!histGeom) return;
    histGeom.index = null;
    histGeom.cross.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden"); histGeom.dot.setAttribute("visibility", "hidden");
    histGeom.tip.hidden = true;
  }
  wireIndexChart($("hist-chart"), function () { return histData; }, function () { return histGeom; }, showHist, hideHist, drawHistory);

  /* ---------- estimated final margin over time ---------- */
  let trendData = [], trendGeom = null;
  function renderTrend(s) {
    trendData = histFromState(s).filter(function (h) { return isNum(h.margin_mid) || isNum(h.reported_margin); });
    $("trend-empty").hidden = trendData.length > 0;
    $("trend-chart").hidden = trendData.length === 0;
    $("trend-keys").hidden = trendData.length === 0;
    const last = trendData[trendData.length - 1];
    if (last) $("trend-chart").setAttribute("aria-label", "Chart of the estimated final margin over time. Latest estimate " + margin(last.margin_mid) +
      ", 90% range " + rangeText(last.margin_lo90, last.margin_hi90) + ". Margin in the count " + margin(last.reported_margin) + ".");
    drawTrend();

  }
  function onFailure() {
    if (lastGood) setNotice("Could not load new data at " + clock(Date.now()) + " PT. Showing the last data received, from " + whenPT(lastGood.updated_at) + ".");
    else { $("state").textContent = "Waiting for data"; setNotice("Live data is not available yet. This page will fill in when the data file loads."); }
  }
  async function poll() {
    const ctl = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(function () { ctl.abort(); }, FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { signal: ctl.signal, cache: "no-store" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
      const text = await res.text();
      const s = JSON.parse(text);
      if (!s || typeof s !== "object" || !s.status) throw new Error("not a state file");
      const older = lastGood && validDate(s.updated_at) && validDate(lastGood.updated_at) && Date.parse(s.updated_at) < Date.parse(lastGood.updated_at);
      if (!older && text !== lastText) { lastText = text; lastGood = s; renderAll(s); }
      setNotice(freshnessNotice(lastGood));
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("needle: fetch failed", err);
      onFailure();
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      setTimeout(poll, POLL_MS);
    }
  }

  renderAll({});
  $("state").textContent = "Loading";
  poll();
})();
</script>
